turns.input: Niles Vanner gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration: Niles Vanner withdrew his hand slowly, the leather boots still dangling from his fingers. "These aren't for giving away, friend. They're stock. Inventory." He turned the boots to show a small chalk mark on the inner ankle—his pricing notation. "If you need footwear, we can discuss terms at the shop. Second Chance, two streets toward the river." He tucked the boots back into his reinforced waistcoat pocket, his thumb finding the empty counterbalance pan to spin idly. "Or if you've something to sell or pledge, same address. I don't make trades in the street."

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration: Niles Vanner has already tucked the boots under his arm, the leather soles pressed against his waistcoat. He half-turns toward the river, then pauses to glance back. Something about the tower owner prompts him to offer: "If you're still deciding what to do with that place, I'd hear a proposal. Pawn takes property as well as goods." He taps one knuckle against his reinforced pocket. "Collateral arrangement, not a sale. You keep the deed, I hold a share of equity. Terms would be modest for a building I've never been inside." He waits, patient, the boots forgotten against his hip.
